The 0.508 V output, line regulation above 1 V/V and PSRR below 0 dB all point to the start-up device staying on after power-up. That holds nb low, so M5 overdrives and vref tracks VDD. I'm rewriting the start-up so it can't stay on and lengthening the PMOS mirror to improve PSRR.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Large line_reg and negative PSRR suggest the start-up stays on and holds nb low, so M5 tracks VDD. Rebuilt start-up with weak, long-L devices, an extra pull-down shutting MS off, and a 20 nA cap. Avoid L=20. Lengthened PMOS mirror for PSRR."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (0.4e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch / output current
    "VP":   (0.55, 0.40, 0.65),          # PTAT voltage I*R2 at 27C
    "a":    (0.72, 0.62, 0.90),          # I*R3 (sets divider k and Q3 current)
    "Lp":   (6.0, 2.0, 10.0),            # PMOS mirror length (PSRR / line reg)
    "Ln":   (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),             # NMOS core length
    "gmp":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),           # PMOS gm/Id
    "gmn":  (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),          # NMOS gm/Id
    "Cg":   (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 3e-12),     # PMOS gate-to-vdd cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; N = 8
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = p["VP"] / I
    R3 = p["a"] / I

    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=0.6)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # self-biased PTAT core (BJT-degenerated beta multiplier): I*R1 = UT*ln(N)
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "na", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "nb", "na", "x2", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "x2", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # output leg: vref = R3/(R2+R3) * (Veb3 + I*R2)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("CG", "nb", "vdd", p["Cg"])
    # start-up: weak pull-up on sx; strong NMOS pull-downs gated by na (~1 V when running)
    # and by e1 (~0.6 V when running) guarantee sx -> 0 and MS fully off in normal operation.
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "sx2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 8.0)
    n.M("MS4", "sx2", "sx2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 8.0)   # series diode: limits pull-up to ~nA
    n.M("MS5", "sx2", "vss", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 8.0)   # off-state leakage path for sx2 bias
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "na", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS6", "sx", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 1.0)     # note: reinforces sx high only when nb low
    n.M("MS", "nb", "sx", "msd", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 4.0)
    n.R("RS", "msd", "vss", 200e3)                              # limits start-up injection
    n.C("CS", "sx", "vss", 20e-15)

    # predictions
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / 10e-6)
    iq3 = 0.1 * I; v3 = veb(iq3)
    for _ in range(30):
        iq3 = max((I * R3 - v3) / (R2 + R3), 1e-10); v3 = veb(iq3)
    k = R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref = k * (v3 + I * R2)
    slope = k * (-2.0e-3 + I * R2 / 300.15)
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 200
    rout = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    dv = mp.gds * rout * 2.0
    psrr = -db(max(dv, 1e-6))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.1e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": dv,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```

Wait — MS6 (gate nb) would pull sx high whenever the mirror conducts, which re-creates the stuck-on start-up. Corrected program without MS6:

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (0.4e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch / output current
    "VP":   (0.55, 0.40, 0.65),          # PTAT voltage I*R2 at 27C
    "a":    (0.72, 0.62, 0.90),          # I*R3 (sets divider k and Q3 current)
    "Lp":   (6.0, 2.0, 10.0),            # PMOS mirror length (PSRR / line reg)
    "Ln":   (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),             # NMOS core length
    "gmp":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),           # PMOS gm/Id
    "gmn":  (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),          # NMOS gm/Id
    "Cg":   (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 3e-12),     # PMOS gate-to-vdd cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; N = 8
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = p["VP"] / I
    R3 = p["a"] / I

    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=0.6)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # self-biased PTAT core: I*R1 = UT*ln(N)
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "na", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "nb", "na", "x2", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "x2", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # output leg: vref = R3/(R2+R3) * (Veb3 + I*R2)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("CG", "nb", "vdd", p["Cg"])
    # start-up: two series long PMOS diodes give a ~nA pull-up on sx; a strong NMOS gated by na
    # (~1 V when running) pulls sx to 0 -> MS off. When the core is off, na ~ 0, sx -> high,
    # MS sinks a resistor-limited current from nb and kicks the mirror on.
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "sx2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 8.0)
    n.M("MS4", "sx2", "sx2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 8.0)
    n.M("MS5", "sx2", "vss", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 8.0)   # leakage sink so sx2 biases MS2 on
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "na", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "nb", "sx", "msd", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 4.0)
    n.R("RS", "msd", "vss", 200e3)                              # limits start-up injection
    n.C("CS", "sx", "vss", 20e-15)

    # predictions
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / 10e-6)
    iq3 = 0.1 * I; v3 = veb(iq3)
    for _ in range(30):
        iq3 = max((I * R3 - v3) / (R2 + R3), 1e-10); v3 = veb(iq3)
    k = R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref = k * (v3 + I * R2)
    slope = k * (-2.0e-3 + I * R2 / 300.15)
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 200
    rout = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    dv = mp.gds * rout * 2.0
    psrr = -db(max(dv, 1e-6))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.1e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": dv,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```

Please run this second program, the one without MS6. In the start-up, only na-gated MS3 pulls sx low. sx is pulled up only by a weak pull-up limited to a few nA. MS is a long-L device with 200 kΩ in series, so even partial conduction can't hold nb low. Lp grows to 6 µm and I to 0.4 µA, and predicted power is about 2.3 µW.
